$description: There are NO box-shadows anywhere in the site-authored stylesheet - every box-shadow in src/styles/fourmula-base.css lives in the Webflow framework partition (lines 1-2077 and the .w-*/.fs-cc_* re-declarations). Elevation here is therefore z-index layers plus two inline blur filters. Do not generate shadows.
idConvention: Token ids are dotted, lower-case, tier-prefix-free. Foundation ids are <category>.<name> (color.mainbg-dark, type.h1, spacing.1, radius.md, breakpoint.tablet, elevation.z-header, icon-size.header-logo, motion.transition.fast). Semantic ids are <role>.<variant> (text.primary, surface.page, border.hairline, accent.primary). Component ids start with component.<name>.<slot>, layout ids with layout.<name>. A "$ref" is always another token id.

elevation.z-raised.role: z-index layer used by .header__main, .hero__wrap, .list__main__bottom-gradient, three .ai__grid-asset anima layers

elevation.z-awwwards-badge.role: Inline z-index on the body-level #awwwards badge (src/components/AwwwardsBadge.jsx:4).

elevation.blur-preloader.role: Inline filter on the three preloader layers; animated away by m21.js.

elevation.blur-image-anima.role: Inline filter on .ai__grid-asset.is-img-anima-5 only; the other four anima layers ship blur(0px).
